<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><meta charset="utf-8"></head>
<body>
<script>
  function post(type, args) {
    try {
      var text = args.map(function(a) {
        if (typeof a === 'string') return a;
        try { return JSON.stringify(a); } catch (_) { return String(a); }
      }).join(' ');
      ConsoleChannel.postMessage(JSON.stringify({type: type, text: text}));
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  console.log = function() { post('log', Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments)); };
  console.info = function() { post('log', Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments)); };
  console.warn = function() { post('warn', Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments)); };
  console.error = function() { post('error', Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments)); };
  window.onerror = function(message, source, lineno) {
    post('error', [message + ' (Zeile ' + lineno + ')']);
    return true;
  };
  try {
    var userCode = atob("{{USER_CODE_BASE64}}");
    (0, eval)(userCode);
  } catch (e) {
    post('error', [e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)]);
  }
</script>
</body>
</html>
